name: Arbitrate Candidate Patches — Clean vs Memory Leak
description: Two competing agent patches exist in candidates/. Agent must evaluate both, reject the leaky patch, and apply the clean patch to src/parser.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Evaluate candidates/a.patch and candidates/b.patch. Apply the clean, non-leaking patch to src/parser.ts so test/parser.test.ts passes. Do not apply the patch that creates global state leaks.

acceptance_criteria: src/parser.ts handles empty and null strings
src/parser.ts does not introduce globalThis leaks
constraints: Do not introduce global variables or leaks
